chunks.content: Built a design-system component library in React and TypeScript, published to the internal npm registry.
Migrated a Redux codebase to Zustand and TanStack Query, shrinking the client bundle by 22 percent.
Wrote a small Rust CLI for image compression at the design agency I used to work at.
Configured Playwright end-to-end tests running in GitHub Actions across three browsers.
Owns a small permaculture homestead on weekends.

query: Frontend engineer to build a React component library in TypeScript for our design system.
